subject: Using shiny objects in a knitr report

messages.author: ad0479edfa13e0ad
messages.subject: Using shiny objects in a knitr report
parts:
Hi all,

I have created a shiny app that renders various plots. I have also created a download button to download a report created with the knitr package. So is there any way to include the plots rendered by my app in the report by refering to them as shiny objects (without the need to rerun the code that produces the plot in the Rmd file)?

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Using shiny objects in a knitr report
parts:
Unfortunately, no, I'm not aware of a way to include the plots in the
app into Rmd. You may abstract the plotting code into a (reactive)
function, and reuse the function in both the app and Rmd.

Regards,
Yihui
